title: David Perla and Michael Redman featured in Legal Business article about 2024 legal finance trends
summary: Burford Vice Chair David Perla and Co-Head of EMEA and Co-Head of Asset Recovery Michael Redman are featured in a Legal Business article discussing the latest trends in legal finance. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Burford Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) and Co-Head of EMEA and Asset RecoveryMichael Redman are featured in a *Legal Business* article discussing the latest trends in legal finance.


Among other topics, the article references shifting perceptions of legal finance as a result of increased use, quoting Perla, who states that legal finance is becoming "much more accepted as a common cost of doing business; as corporate finance for law."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.legalbusiness.co.uk/analysis/its-always-a-fight-us-and-uk-funders-on-a-busy-year-battling-davids-goliaths-and-regulation/)
